Kilmarnock Football Club is a Scottish professional football team based in the town of Kilmarnock in East Ayrshire, that currently plays in the Scottish Premiership. The club has achieved several honours since its formation in 1869, most recently the 2011–12 Scottish League Cup after a 1–0 win over Celtic at Hampden Park and the Scottish Championship title in 2022. The club nickname, Killie, is the Scottish term for the town of Kilmarnock.
